subject: Tournament visual QC + shareable post-event recap (Panopticon capture -> podium recap artifact)
description:
Operator idea 2026-08-20: drive the tournament as a real user, capture every screen, turn the podium into a shareable recap that exists AFTER the event.

FEASIBILITY PROVEN, NOT BUILT. Full build sheet: _docs/operations/tournament-capture-and-recap-spec.md

Proven: headless capture works on bc1 via ghcr.io/puppeteer/puppeteer (336KB PNG, 1600x900 @2x, first working run). Must run on bc1, NOT the deploy host - headless Chrome under WSL2 stalls ~50% of runs. /tmp/out needs chmod 777 (image runs as pptruser).

BLOCKER: arena pages are AccessGuard-gated. The proof capture of spectator.html returned HTTP 200 but title 'Welcome, Explorer' - the guard bounced the unauthenticated browser. NOT a Firestore rules problem (tournaments are allow read: if true for exactly this reason); it is the client-side guard. Harness needs an authenticated session: inject a Firebase ID token into localStorage via evaluateOnNewDocument. That needs a service account with signBlob, which the local ADC lacks - the same thing that blocked verify-deliverflag-guard.js. Resolve that first.

Then: seed a disposable demo tournament (visible:true REQUIRED now that ctfSubmitFlag refuses hidden challenges), capture lobby/board/Panopticon/broadcast/podium at desktop AND mobile, build the recap as an Artifact from REAL data, delete the demo and verify.
